title: External MySQL Dependency — awbc_db
summary: The Odoo service on CT201 and CT202 depends at runtime on an external MySQL 8.0 database on host 192.168.21.206. This database (awbc_db) is an ITAD/hardware refurbishment tracking platform (AWB Client system). gr_project_inventory reads from it via PyMySQL to generate hardware device reports (CPU, RAM, storage, grade, COA, photos) for each processed unit.

connection.python_driver: PyMySQL==1.1.2 (installed in venv on all environments)

tables.name: Units_Pictures
tables.note: DOMINANT TABLE — device photos as LONGBLOB. 88% of total DB size.

tables.name: Units_Devices
tables.note: Per-component hardware scan records. ~18 rows per unit on average. Categories: CPU, RAM, STORAGE, LCD, BATTERY, BOARD, COA, VIDEO, KEYBOARD, OPTICAL, WEBCAM.

tables.name: Units
tables.note: Core asset/unit record. One row per physical device. Contains Grade, SerialNumber, Chassis, Manufacturer, Model, WarehLocation, HwID, ObservCodes.

tables.name: Clients_Formats
tables.note: Report format definitions (blob/longblob params). Used to configure export formats per client.

tables.name: Lots
tables.note: Lot/batch records. Each lot groups multiple Units. Fields: LotID, Number, Owner, Customer, Description, Status, Created, Uploaded.

tables.name: Lots_Owners
tables.note: Owner/ITAD partner reference table. Fields: ID, Name, Common, Itad, Data(longblob).

tables.name: OSImages
tables.note: OS image catalog for restoration procedures.

views.name: Units_Reports
views.purpose: PRIMARY REPORT VIEW — pivots Units + Units_Devices across all hardware categories into a flat per-unit row. Consumed by gr_project_inventory to generate technical device reports.
views.note: Uses stored function FREFURB() to switch between original (Grade/ObservCodes/User/Audited) and refurbished (RGrade/RObservCodes/RUser/RAudited) component data. Character set: latin1 — ENCODING RISK for French accented text.

views.name: NEW_Units_Reports
views.purpose: Superset of Units_Reports — adds HwID, BatterySize, Videocard2, WarehLocation, PackGroupNumber. Likely the current production view used by gr_project_inventory.
views.note: Defined by root@localhost, not manager@% — different privilege chain than Units_Reports.

views.name: Units_Reports_LotParam
views.note: Lot-level parameter report view — not deeply inspected.

odoo_integration.python_access_method: PyMySQL==1.1.2 (direct SQL queries from gr_project_inventory models)
odoo_integration.connection_injected_via: systemd Environment= vars (MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_DATABASE)
odoo_integration.primary_use: Pulling Units_Reports / NEW_Units_Reports view data to populate hardware specification fields in Odoo project tasks / inventory records
odoo_integration.secondary_use: Lots and Lots_Owners for batch/lot context in reports
odoo_integration.criticality: CRITICAL — without this connection, gr_project_inventory cannot generate hardware reports for processed units. Core business output depends on it.
odoo_integration.failure_mode: If 192.168.21.206 is unreachable or credentials change, all report generation in gr_project_inventory silently fails or raises MySQL exceptions

risks.title: Credentials in plaintext systemd unit — both CT201 and CT202
risks.note: Any process with root/sudo on the container can read the password.

risks.title: 192.168.21.206 is an undocumented host — not in SSH config, not in known_hosts
risks.note: No information on what server this is, who operates it, what its backup/HA story is, or whether it is accessible from any future CI/container environment.

risks.title: latin1 charset — encoding risk for French text
risks.note: The Units_Reports view uses latin1/latin1_swedish_ci. French accented characters in Manufacturer/Model/ObservNotes may be mangled when read into Python 3 (UTF-8). Must be handled in the PyMySQL connection config.

risks.title: FREFURB() stored function — state-dependent view output
risks.note: The Units_Reports view calls FREFURB() stored function to decide which grade/observation/user fields to return. The output of the view depends on the server-side session state. This makes the view non-deterministic from a consumer perspective without understanding the function.

risks.title: Units_Pictures LONGBLOB data — 311MB in DB
risks.note: Device photos are stored as LONGBLOB in MySQL. If gr_project_inventory ever reads these, it will be slow and memory-intensive. Should be offloaded to object storage if used.

risks.title: No access from local dev — cannot test report generation locally
risks.note: 192.168.21.206 is only reachable from inside the 192.168.21.x network (CT201/CT202). Local dev cannot connect to awbc_db without a tunnel. Report-related code paths are untestable locally.
